name: Dream Nexus
permanentEffect: Systems that contain your nexus tokens are nebulas. Your ship's movement is not affected by these nebulas.

name: The Waking
window: At the end of the status phase:
windowEffect: Any player with ships in a system that contains a nexus token may remove 1 token from 1 of those systems.

name: Incomprehensible Form
window: When 1 of your ships would be destroyed during space combat:
windowEffect: You may instead remove 1 nexus token from the active system.

name: Fragmentation
window: After one of your non-fighter ships is destroyed:
windowEffect: You may capture 1 fighter from the supply.

name: Pieces of a Whole
window: At the start of space combat:
windowEffect: You mayu return up to 2 captured fighters from your faction sheet to place that many fighters from your reinforcements in the active system.

name: Burning Legion
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Place 12 infantry from the supply on your faction sheet. These units are captured. When your infantry are removed or destroyed, capture them.

name: Forged in Fire
window: When a game effect would have you place or produce infantry:
windowEffect: You must return 1 captured infantry for each infantry placed or produced, instead of spending resources.

name: Mechanized Military
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Take the 3 additional Iron Tide mechs and place them in your reinforcements; You have 7 mechs.

name: Exo-Atmospheric
permanentEffect: Your mechs count as ships when in the space area of a system and may participate in space combat.

name: Iron Resilience
permanentEffect: Your mechs roll an additional combat die while they are damaged.

name: Planetary Reconfiguration
window: After you explore a planet:
windowEffect: You may attach 1 of your designs from your reinforcements to that planet if it does not already have one. When you lose control of a planet with a design attached to it, return that card to your reinforcements. Designs do not count as attachments for the purposes of scoring objectives.

name: Efficient Governance
window: During the agenda phase, after an outcome you voted for is resolved:
windowEffect: Ready up to 2 of your planets.

name: Neural Instruments
window: When any other player gains a technology, or exhausts a technology for its effect:
windowEffect: Place 1 of that player's control tokens on your faction sheet. You may not have more than 1 of each player's control token on your faction sheet at a time.

name: Proxy Network
window: At the start of your turn:
windowEffect: You may remove 1 player's control token from your faction sheet and select 1 of that player's non-faction technologies. Treat that technology as if you own it until the end of your turn.

name: Reverse Engineering
window: Once per round, at the end of your turn:
windowEffect: You may spend a token from your strategy pool to gain the technology you selected at the start of this turn using your Proxy Network ability.

name: Doctrine
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Take the 6 Natau doctrines and place them in your reinforcements. Then, choose 2 doctrines; place them in your play area and ready them.

name: Paradigm
window: At the start of the status phase:
windowEffect: Ready each doctrine. Then, replace 1 of the doctrines in your play area with a doctrine from your reinforcements.

name: Dark Power
permanentEffect: Each time you start or end your movement in an anomaly, gain 1 commodity.

name: Wrath
permanentEffect:
During combat:
Your units with SUSTAIN DAMAGE roll an additional combat die while not damaged.
window: You may exhaust this card at the start of a combat to choose 2 other player's ships
windowEffect: Those ships apply -1 to their combat rolls until the end of that combat.

name: Strength
permanentEffect:
At the start of combat:
Choose 1 of your participating units to gain SUSTAIN DAMAGE until the end of combat.
window: When another player uses a unit ability against your units
windowEffect: You may exhaust thsi card to cancel up to 2 of those hits.

name: Revelation
permanentEffect:
When you gain this card:
Choose 2 non-objective common decks and place them on either side of this card. You may look at the top card of either of these decks at any time.
window: When you would draw a card from any common deck
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to draw an additional card; choose 1 to keep or resolve and shuffle the rest back into that common deck.
notes: This does not allow you to draw an additional agenda during the primary ability of the Politics strategy card, as you are not drawing from the deck, only looking at the top 2. However, this does allow you to draw 2 agendas during the agenda phase if you are the speaker, and choose which one to vote on.

name: Knowledge
permanentEffect:
When you research a technology owned by one of your neighbors:
You may ignore 1 prerequisite on that technology.
window: After you research a technology
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card and 1 planet you control that has a technology specialty to research a technology of that color.

name: Discovery
permanentEffect:
When you would resolve the effects of an exploration card:
You may choose to discard that card without resolving its effects to gain 1 trade good.
window: At the end of a tactical action
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to explore the frontier deck in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships and no planets.

name: Stability
permanentEffect:
When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION, if you produce 3 or more non-fighter ships:
You may produce an additional 2 fighters or infantry at no cost. These units do not count against your PRODUCTION limit.
window: When you use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your units
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks in a different system that does not contain your command tokens or another player's ships. If you do, place a command token from your reinforcements into that system.
